purpose: Separate design-based mitigation of opportunistic-photo bias from explicit post hoc robustness diagnostics, without changing the frozen primary RGFCA estimand or using flower-colour outcomes to choose corrections.

layers.name: all_research_photo_records
layers.description: All research-grade, georeferenced, species-rank photo records in the focal plant clade, without licence or flowering-annotation restriction. This is an observer/platform availability proxy, not pure biological abundance or pure sampling effort.

layers.name: license_eligible_photo_records
layers.description: Same query with the fixed reusable-photo licence set; quantifies the extra geographic filter introduced by image reuse eligibility.

layers.name: flowering_annotated_eligible_records
layers.description: Same licence-eligible query plus the frozen flowering annotation; quantifies the extra geographic filter introduced by annotation availability.

outputs: per-cell total_results for each of the three layers
licence-eligible fraction of all photo records

observer_unique_realization_sensitivity.rule: Within each species and realization, retain at most one classifiable photograph per observer before choosing the 20-photo sensitivity draw.
observer_unique_realization_sensitivity.feasibility: A species enters this sensitivity only when at least 20 distinct observers retain classifiable photographs. No threshold is relaxed and no primary result is replaced.

high_effort_cell_deletion_sensitivity.rule: Delete the top decile of equal-area cells by pre-frozen log1p sampling-availability count and recompute the complete observed/null RGFCA program on the remaining support.
high_effort_cell_deletion_sensitivity.role: robustness sensitivity only; cannot rescue a null primary G1 or replace the primary field

sampling_availability_negative_controls.statistic: opportunity-weighted Spearman correlation across jointly evaluable cells
sampling_availability_negative_controls.null: Use the same 999 species-conditioned colour permutations and fixed geometry as primary RGFCA; do not introduce a favourable alternative null.
sampling_availability_negative_controls.interpretation: A strong observed colour-field association with an availability/annotation layer that is not exceptional under the matched null is treated as sampling-confounded evidence.

report: largest observer share before and after the cap
fraction of primary realization photos contributed by repeated observers

what_this_can_reduce: dominance by prolific observers within species
dominance by species with very large public-photo archives
local geographic clustering of retained photographs
global field inflation caused simply by more sampled edges in popular regions
fragility to one realm or one major family
dependence of a claimed zone on the highest-observation cells
what_this_cannot_identify_or_remove: species and regions with effectively zero public-photo sampling probability
phenotype-dependent upload choice, including preferential photography of unusual flower colours
camera, illumination and post-processing effects not removed by the fixed image estimator
a causal decomposition of biological abundance versus human observation effort from opportunistic occurrence counts alone
claim_ceiling: A robust RGFCA result may be described as stable to several major forms of observer, taxonomic, spatial-opportunity and metadata-availability bias within the public-photo sampling frame. It must not be described as unbiased for all angiosperms, all geographic areas or the true unsampled frequency of colour morphs.
